description: Land Acquisition - Milidduwa, Maligaspe D/S Division, Four Gravets Galle, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
